lead.question: 喜欢乡间旅行的作者，为什么没能在目的地伍德福德草地下车？
lead.warmup: 坐上一辆乡村巴士，把目的地交代给售票员，听起来省心——前提是他真记得提醒你下车。本课作者正是如此：他爱在乡间旅行，却最怕迷路；上车时坦言不知道伍德福德草地在哪儿，售票员满口答应“我来告诉您在哪儿下车”。于是他安心坐在车前部看风景，直到车停下才发现，整辆车只剩他自己……
goals: 掌握 ride、excursion、conductor、view 等核心词的词义与搭配
分清 get on / get off、put off、in the front of / in front of 等易混短语
掌握“疑问词 + 不定式”结构及 as far as、prefer to do 的用法
复习一般现在时表习惯与状态、状态动词不用于进行时的规则
lead.summary: 故事讲的是一次“被兜了风”的旅行：作者要去伍德福德草地，却不知它在哪儿，只能指望售票员提醒。他坐在车前部饱览乡间景色，等车停下才惊觉车上只剩自己——售票员早忘了让他下车。此时车已到终点、马上要返回，作者索性说“既然如此，我还是留在车上吧”。
lead.tips: 标题 taken for a ride 一语双关：字面是“被带着乘车兜风”，口语里还有“被耍、受骗”的意思；in the front of（内部的前部）不同于 in front of（外部的前方）。

questions.q: Why did the writer not get off the bus at Woodford Green?
questions.zh: 作者为什么没有在伍德福德草地站下车？
questions.a: Because the conductor forgot to put him off; the bus had gone past Woodford Green and was going back.
questions.aZh: 因为售票员忘了让他下车，车已经开过了伍德福德草地，而且马上要原路返回。

questions.q: Where did the writer sit on the bus, and why did he choose that seat?
questions.zh: 作者坐在车上哪个位置？为什么选那个位置？
questions.a: He sat in the front of the bus to get a good view of the countryside.
questions.aZh: 他坐在汽车的前部，以便饱览农村风光。
questions.hint: I sat in the front of the bus…

questions.q: What did the writer realize when he looked round after the bus stopped?
questions.zh: 车停下后，作者环视四周发现了什么？
questions.a: He realized with a shock that he was the only passenger left on the bus.
questions.aZh: 他惊奇地发现，车上只剩他一个乘客了。
questions.hint: Looking round, I realized with a shock that…

questions.q: Where did the writer want to go, and what did he say to the conductor as he got on the bus?
questions.zh: 作者想去哪儿？上车时对售票员说了什么？
questions.a: He wanted to go to Woodford Green. He said, 'I'm going to Woodford Green, but I don't know where it is.'
questions.aZh: 他要去伍德福德草地，说：“我要去伍德福德草地，但我不知道它在哪儿。”
questions.hint: as I got on the bus 中 as 表示“当……时”。

questions.q: What is the joke in the title 'Taken for a ride', and why did the writer finally prefer to stay on the bus?
questions.zh: 标题妙在何处？作者最后为何宁愿留在车上？
questions.a: Literally he was given a bus ride he had not planned; idiomatically 'take someone for a ride' means to cheat or fool someone. He stayed on the bus because it was going back and he doesn't like losing his way in the country.
questions.aZh: 字面意思是他被带着多坐了一段车；短语 take sb. for a ride 还有“耍弄”的意思。他留在车上是因为车要原路返回，而他不愿在乡间迷路。
questions.hint: 把首句与结尾 in that case, I prefer to stay on the bus 对照。

exercises.q: 填空：I love travelling in the country, but I don't like ______ ______ ______.
汉译英：最近我作了一次短途旅行，但这次旅行花的时间比我预计的要长。
exercises.a: I went on an excursion recently, but my trip took me longer than I expected.
exercises.note: go on an excursion 去远足。

exercises.q: 填空：“I'm going to Woodford Green,” I said to the ______ as I ______ ______ the bus.
用“疑问词 + 不定式”改写：The conductor didn't tell me where I should get off.
exercises.a: The conductor didn't tell me where to get off.
exercises.note: where to get off 作 tell 的宾语。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我坐在汽车的前部，以便饱览农村风光。
exercises.a: I sat in the front of the bus to get a good view of the countryside.
exercises.note: in the front of 前部。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我们的车就到此为止了。
exercises.a: This is as far as we go.
exercises.note: as far as 表示“到……的限度”。

exercises.q: 简答：课文用 I love travelling，为什么不用 I am loving travelling？
exercises.a: love、like 表示喜好与心理状态，通常只用一般现在时；love / like doing 强调一贯习惯，不用于进行时。
exercises.note: 状态动词一般不用进行时。

quiz.q: 售票员突然发现自己忘了让作者下车，他说的是哪一句？
options: I forgot to put you off.
I forgot to get you on.
I forgot to take you down.
I forgot to let you away.
quiz.note: put off 在此意为“让……下车”。

quiz.q: “我坐在汽车的前部”正确的英文表达是：
options: I sat in the front of the bus.
I sat in front of the bus.
I sat on the front of the bus.
I sat in the front bus.
quiz.note: in the front of 指内部的前部。

quiz.q: “我们的车就到此为止了”应译为：
options: This is as far as we go.
This is so far as we go.
This is as far than we go.
This is as far as we are going to.
quiz.note: as far as 表示“到……的限度”。

quiz.q: 作者说不知道伍德福德草地在哪儿，售票员的回答是：
options: I'll tell you where to get off.
I'll tell you where getting off.
I'll tell you where you get off.
I'll tell you where should you get off.
quiz.note: 疑问副词 where + 不定式作宾语。

quiz.q: 课文中表示“迷路”的固定搭配是：
options: lose one's way
lose one's road
miss one's road
lose the street
quiz.note: lose one's way，也可说 get lost。

quiz.q: 听说车要返回，作者回答的是：
options: Well, in that case, I prefer to stay on the bus.
Well, in that case, I prefer stay on the bus.
Well, in that case, I prefer to stay in the bus.
Well, in that case, I prefer to stay at the bus.
